newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump, inspired by U.S. stock market.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump, inspired by U.S. stock market.

text.p: Tokyo stocks jumped in the early Thursday session, bolstered by a rise in the U.S. stock markets overnight, brokers said.
They said that bellwether issues such as Sony Corp were attracting attention and leading indices higher.
As of 0025 GMT, the Nikkei average was 283.42 points or 1.48 percent higher at 19,434.54. Its June futures were 210 points higher at 19,460.
"If dealers become over-enthusiastic due to the start of the new calendar month, the gains may be difficult to hold onto in the latter half of the session," one broker said.
